videos.title: Cloud gaming works — but it's not winning
videos.description:
Streaming all your video games seems like such a good, simple idea. All your games, everywhere, on any screen you like — it's the dream! The Verge's Sean Hollister explains how the tech works now (which might be better than you think), why it'll take a huge amount of work to make it even a little bit better, and why games like Grand Theft Auto VI probably can't just live in the cloud.

videos.title: Has Instagram given up on celeb deepfakes?
videos.description:
A photo of Mia Goth wearing a t-shirt referencing her ex-husband Shia LaBeouf recently went viral, but it wasn’t real. The AI-generated image was posted by a fan-run Instagram account with a blue verification check, and was picked up by gossip sites and Google’s AI overview as legitimate. Has Instagram given up on fighting celebrity deepfakes?
